message.content: It started about two weeks after I had cold or respiratory infection symptoms, and since then the shortness of breath has been getting worse with activity, along with swelling in my legs and some belly pain. I don’t know if it’s worse when I lie flat or if it wakes me up at night. I also can’t really say exactly where in my belly the pain is or whether it’s crampy or related to meals, and I don’t know about abdominal swelling or weight gain.
